inventory.text: EVST's inspected guide does not publish fixed list prices; its quoted bands are complete-cell budgets, not a $25k–$80k robot-arm range.
Any retained calculator sourcing of 2–3x complete-cell/arm ratio and 12–24 month multi-shift guidance remains a vendor statement, not a chosen-value certificate.
The calculator's $80000 robotCost is an authored example, with $20000–$250000 range/5000 step, not a reported price; other model defaults and chosen horizon remain explicit assumptions.
At fixed other example inputs, changing robotCost changes total cell capital, capital cost per modeled pick and modeled payback according to the existing formula.
